name: Christmas 2026
description: Snow on the deck, a parcel with your name on it, and a sleigh that will not fly until every crew has filled it. Four weeks, forty quests, and a whole month of snowflakes to spend.
final_message: Every door opened, every parcel wrapped, every crew fed. The sleigh is yours — merry Christmas, and mind the ice. 🎄
notes: Christmas 2026 event pass. Before this goes live: (1) the Christmas 2026 special needs its artwork and a rarity above 0, or no catch-a-Christmas quest can be done; (2) the same special has to be picked in the Secret Santa, the advent calendar, the sleigh and the shop in the admin; (3) position 0 makes this the pass /pass view opens in December, so raise it if another event should win. The pass loads as a DRAFT and only staff see it in /pass view until it is set Active: that is the admin-only state to test it in. The quests that drive the event features count uses of a slash command, so note that advent catchup does NOT count towards the advent open quests. A player who catches up on missed days will not finish Twenty Doors, which is why it asks for 20 and not 25. The two Secret Santa wrapping quests are both optional on purpose: giving a card (santa gift) and paying in snowflakes (santa pay) are two paths to the same thing, and neither should be the only way to finish a tier. Five quests are hidden (A Flake of Your Own, Blizzard Runner, Full Stocking, Snowflake Baron, Nobody Asked You To): players only see them once completed, and they never count towards finishing a tier. Snowflakes handed out: about 1880 over the whole pass, plus 10 a day from the daily, against shop boosts priced 100 to 250.

tiers.name: The First Snow
tiers.description: The sea goes quiet, the rigging goes white, and a calendar nobody remembers hanging turns up on the mast. Open it.
tiers.completion_message: The first snow has settled, and the Snow Snow fruit is yours. ❄️

quests.name: Hung on the Mast
quests.description: Find out what the fuss is about: open the advent calendar with /advent view.

quests.name: The First Door
quests.description: One door a day, no cheating. Open today's with /advent open.

quests.name: Snow Patrol
quests.description: Somebody has to keep watch in this weather. Catch 20 treasures.

quests.name: Something in the Snow
quests.description: It is not a seagull. Catch a Christmas 2026 treasure.

quests.name: Letter to Santa
quests.description: Sign your name on the list: join the Secret Santa with /santa join.

quests.name: Three Wishes
quests.description: Tell your Santa what you actually want: fill all three slots of your wishlist with /santa wish.

quests.name: Warming Up
quests.description: Claim your daily berries three days in a row — the snowflakes come with them.

quests.name: Load the Sleigh
quests.description: The sleigh is empty and it is not going anywhere. Put a treasure in it with /sleigh give.

quests.name: Gift Wrapped
quests.description: Give 3 treasures to people on your friend list. No strings, no trade.

quests.name: A Flake of Your Own
quests.description: Nobody told you to hoard them. Five Christmas treasures already sitting in your collection.
quests.completion_message: Five already. December has barely started.

tiers.name: Winter Island
tiers.description: The log pose settles on an island of snow, a castle on stilts and a doctor who shoots at visitors. Climb it anyway.
tiers.completion_message: The drum mountains are behind you, and an admiral of ice walks down with you. 🧊

quests.name: Drum Rock Climb
quests.description: Straight up, no ropes: catch 50 treasures.

quests.name: Snowstorm
quests.description: They come down thick up here. Catch 3 Christmas 2026 treasures.

quests.name: Eight Doors Down
quests.description: Keep at the calendar: open 8 doors in all.

quests.name: Shopping Trip
quests.description: Snowflakes are for spending: buy something with /shop buy.

quests.name: Hot Chocolate
quests.description: A week of it, every morning. Claim your daily berries seven days in a row.

quests.name: Secret Keeper
quests.description: Find out whose Santa you are with /santa target. Tell nobody.

quests.name: The Quack Doctor
quests.description: He cured the island and nobody thanked him. Catch Doctor Hiriluk.

quests.name: Ice Breaker
quests.description: Nobody crosses a winter island alone: complete 3 trades with friends.

quests.name: Loaded Sleigh
quests.description: Your crew is counting: put 5 treasures in the sleigh.

quests.name: Blizzard Runner
quests.description: You never even saw them land. Five treasures caught in under seven seconds.
quests.completion_message: Faster than the snow. The sleigh noticed.

tiers.name: The Great Feast
tiers.description: Whole Cake Island hears there is a party and invites itself. Candy, packs, merchants and a sleigh that still is not full.
tiers.completion_message: The table is cleared, the Emperor is fed, and she came back with you. 🍰

quests.name: Feast Preparations
quests.description: This many mouths need this many treasures: catch 100.

quests.name: Candy Rain
quests.description: It is snowing sweets. Catch 6 Christmas 2026 treasures.

quests.name: Halfway Down the Calendar
quests.description: Fifteen doors open, sixteen to go.

quests.name: Crew Delivery
quests.description: The sleigh takes everything you can carry: 15 treasures given to it.

quests.name: Wrap the Parcel
quests.description: Somebody is waiting on you: fill your Secret Santa parcel with a card, using /santa gift.

quests.name: Paid in Snow
quests.description: No card to spare? Buy your way out of it: fill your parcel with /santa pay.

quests.name: Sweets Merchant
quests.description: Buy 3 items from the merchant. It is the season for it.

quests.name: A Pile of Presents
quests.description: Buy 5 packs, any packs. Shake them first.

quests.name: Christmas Shopping
quests.description: Nobody saves in December: spend 100,000 berries, anywhere.

quests.name: The Candy Man
quests.description: He licks everything he owns. Catch Charlotte Perospero.

quests.name: Twelve Days
quests.description: Claim your daily berries twelve days in a row.

quests.name: Full Stocking
quests.description: Twenty Christmas treasures in one collection. Somebody has been busy.
quests.completion_message: Twenty. The stocking does not close any more.

tiers.name: Christmas Morning
tiers.description: The parcels can be opened, the sleigh is heavy, and whatever is left over falls out of it on the twenty-sixth. Last week.
tiers.completion_message: The reindeer is aboard and the parcels are all open. That is Christmas done properly. 🦌

quests.name: Christmas Morning
quests.description: It has your name on it. Open your Secret Santa parcel with /santa open.

quests.name: Twenty Doors
quests.description: Twenty doors opened on the day they were meant to be. Catching up later does not count.

quests.name: Snow Mountain
quests.description: Ten of them, caught by your own hand. Catch 10 Christmas 2026 treasures.

quests.name: The Last Mile
quests.description: The month asks for one more push: catch 150 treasures.

quests.name: Something Rare Under the Tree
quests.description: Only trophies now: catch 3 treasures of T40 or rarer.

quests.name: Generous Soul
quests.description: Give 10 treasures to friends before the year runs out.

quests.name: Boxing Day
quests.description: Whatever the sleigh could not carry falls out of it. Catch 5 Christmas 2026 treasures from the twenty-sixth onwards.

quests.name: All Month Long
quests.description: Never missed a single morning: a daily berry streak of twenty-five days.

quests.name: Snowflake Baron
quests.description: Thirty Christmas treasures. At this point the snow works for you.
quests.completion_message: Thirty. Nobody is out-collecting you this winter.

quests.name: Nobody Asked You To
quests.description: Twenty-five treasures given away to friends over one December. Nobody asked, and nobody will forget.
quests.completion_message: Twenty-five presents given. Merry Christmas from the whole crew. 🎄
